blocks.text: Bony fishes (haddi wali machhliyon) mein haddi ka endoskeleton, streamlined (paani ko kaatne wala) jism, jild ke haddi wale (dermal bony) scales, aur saamne (terminal) mouth hota hai jis mein jabre hote hain (daanton ke saath ya baghair). Notochord ki jagah vertebral column aa jata hai, lekin kuch bony fishes mein notochord chhoti shakal mein reh jata hai. In mein swim bladder hota hai jo buoyancy (paani mein tairte rehne) mein madad karta hai. In mein median fins (dorsal, caudal aur anal, yani beech ki line wale) aur paired fins (pelvic aur pectoral, yani joron wale) dono hote hain. Gills ke chaar jore hote hain, aur haddi ka ek hifazati dhakkan, operculum, gills ko dhaanpta hai. Nervous system achhi tarah bana hai, jis mein cranial nerves ke das jore hote hain. Fertilization zyada tar external hoti hai. Meethe paani ki bony fishes: rohu, trout, katla, catfish wagaira. Samandari bony fishes: seahorse, flying fish aur angler fish wagaira.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab median (akele, beech ki line wale) fins mein dorsal, caudal aur “ventral” likhti hai. “Ventral fins” pelvic fins ka purana naam hai, aur pelvic fins jore (paired) mein hote hain. Sahi: median fins dorsal, caudal aur anal hain; paired fins pectoral aur pelvic hain, jaisa oopar likha hai.

blocks.alt: Upar ki qataar: Lungfish, Seahorse, Rohu (laal fins wali neeli machhli) aur Trout. Rohu se ek teer neeche haddi wali machhli ki andar ki banawat tak jata hai: dorsal, caudal, pelvic aur anal fins; eye, nostril aur brain; aadhe kate operculum ke neeche gills; heart aur liver; peeth ke saath spinal cord, kidney aur swim bladder; stomach, intestine, gonad, urinary bladder aur anus.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.22: Haddi wali machhliyon ki numainda misaalein aur aam banawat (kitab ki Figure 1.22 ke mutabiq asal khaaka)

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Operculum gills ko dhaanpne wala haddi ka dhakkan hai; khaake mein us ka kuch hissa kaat kar neeche gills dikhaye gaye hain. Neela lamba thaila swim bladder hai jis mein gas bhar kar machhli paani mein upar neeche rehti hai (buoyancy). Shark ke baraks yahan gills bahar se nazar nahi aate. Dorsal, caudal aur anal fins akele (median) hain; pelvic fins jore mein hain.
